title: User can log in successfully
description: Verify that a user can log in with valid credentials.

steps.description: Fill the input field with type 'email' with the value 'testqa@sellora.com'
Fill the input field with type 'password' with the value 'password123'
Click the 'Sign in' or 'Sign In' or 'Login' button
Verify that 'Dashboard' or 'Overview' is visible on the page, indicating a successful login

title: User can navigate to New Analysis
description: Verify that after logging in, the user can navigate to the New Analysis or Analytics section.

steps.description: Fill the input field with type 'email' with 'testqa@sellora.com'
Fill the input field with type 'password' with 'password123'
Click the 'Sign in' or 'Sign In' or 'Login' button
Click on the 'New Analysis' or 'Analytics' or similar item in the navigation menu
Verify that the user navigated to a page where a 'Product Name' or 'Analysis' header/input is visible
